I can't access NAS-Bench-201 data here, so these are structural priors, not measured effects. Most interaction hypotheses need a consistent effect across all three datasets, so I've kept most estimates low. Where the path structure suggests a clear direction (e.g., removing an edge matters less when a strong alternative path exists), I've scored higher or lower accordingly.
